recomputation: none. The sealed R1 bank is not rerun and not rescored. No operator, estimator, gate or score is recomputed. Only the report and the artifact manifest are re-emitted, from the same committed builder against the same tables

freeze_preserved.rule: preserved byte for byte. Nothing in this amendment edits it, including the stale string documented below: a freeze that is corrected after the run it governed is no longer a freeze

authoritative_attestation.captured: at the start of the run, before any operator existed
authoritative_attestation.rule: this is the record that decides whether the result was preregistered. It is clean

report_assembly_recorded_separately.captured: when the report and artifact manifest were written, after the numbers existed
report_assembly_recorded_separately.reason: the report builder was untracked when it first ran, so the assembly attestation reported an unclean tree. The builder reads canonical tables and writes prose; it cannot change a score. The execution attestation, taken before the run, was clean
report_assembly_recorded_separately.remedy: the builder is committed and the report and manifest are re-emitted from it; the manifest now carries execution_attestation and report_assembly_attestation as separate fields with the execution one marked authoritative

rebuilt_from_the_committed_builder.note: digests after the rebuild are recorded in the artifact manifest itself and in the canonical freeze

stale_selection_metadata.history: copied verbatim from the R0 canary pilot freeze into the R0C freeze and from there into the R1 freeze, together with the rest of the hyperparameter_grids block. It names the endpoint that was retired by R0C

what_actually_ran.selection_rule_recorded_on_every_row: lexicographic on the repair-validation bank, primary cell (0.25, 0.95)

corroboration_inside_the_same_freeze.note: the freeze's own operative fields name (0.25, 0.95); only the copied narrative string is stale

stale_selection_metadata.effect_on_the_result: none. The R1 runner reads hyperparameters from r0c_estimator_selection.parquet by (arm, estimator, SNR) and never parses this string

instructions_discharged: 3a preserve the freeze byte for byte
3e rebuild the report and artifact manifest from the committed builder
3g document the stale selection metadata and the actual provenance
